description_en: Queries the SQL execution information of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in elastic storage mode within a specified time period
description_zh: 本接口用于查看指定时间段的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版存储弹性模式实例的SQL执行信息
name: DescribeDiagnosisMonitorPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The filter conditions for the query. The value must be in JSON format. Valid values:

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`: The 100 queries that take the longest time to execute.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: Completed queries.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`: Running queries.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`: Queries with custom execution durations. You can specify the minimum and maximum execution durations. Min specifies the minimum execution duration. Max specifies the maximum execution duration. Unit: milliseconds.
    - If you specify only Min, the system returns queries whose execution duration is greater than the specified value.
    - If you specify only Max, the system returns queries whose execution duration is less than the specified value.
    - If you specify both Min and Max, the system returns queries whose execution duration is greater than or equal to the value of Min and less than or equal to the value of Max
parameters.help_zh:
查询过滤条件，JSON格式，取值如下：

`{"Type":"maxCost", "Value":"100"}`：耗时最长的100个查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：已完成的查询。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"running"}`：运行中的查询。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"30","Max":"50"}`：自定义耗时查询，您可以自定义设置查询的最短耗时和最长耗时，Min表示最短耗时；Max表示最长耗时，单位为毫秒（ms）。
    - 仅设置Min表示查询执行耗时大于该值的查询。
    - 仅设置Max表示查询执行耗时小于该值的查询。
    - 设置Min和Max表示查询耗时大于等于Min的值且小于等于Max的值的查询
parameters.name: query_condition

Cost.description_en: The total execution time of the query. Unit: milliseconds
Cost.description_zh: 查询运行的总时间，单位为毫秒（ms）

QueryID.description_en: The ID of the query, which is the unique identifier of the query
QueryID.description_zh: 查询ID，即查询的唯一标识

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间，为毫秒级UNIX时间戳

Status.description_en:
The execution status of the query. Valid values:

running: Running.
finished: Completed
Status.description_zh:
查询的执行状态，取值如下：

running：执行中。
finished：已完成

PerformancesThreshold.description_en: The threshold for the number of queries

PerformancesTruncated.description_en:
Indicates whether the number of queries is truncated. Valid values:

true: Truncated.
false: Not truncated
PerformancesTruncated.description_zh:
查询数量是否截断，取值如下：

true：截断。
false：不截断
